remarks: Classic 3 Bedroom Colonial in the heart of Westport set on a picturesque level .21-acre. Full of potential, this home awaits your creative vision. Good flow and hardwood floors throughout. Flat, pretty property with city water and sewer available nearby. Detached one car garage. Ideally located just a short walk to the Saugatuck River, train, restaurants, shops, the Rowing Club, and coveted Saugatuck Center. Bike to Compo Beach, Longshore Park and golf course, Ned Dimes Marina, the Westport Farmers' Market, Salmon Park, The Levitt Pavilion, Westport Library, The Westport Country Playhouse, and downtown Westport. Home is being sold "as-is". Amazing opportunity for a buyer, designer, investor or builder who understands the great potential in this most sought-after neighborhood.
